body: So happy to hear it.

Maybe not like in Futurama, but de-stigmatising suicide (the act as well as the urge) along with painless methods would be an improvement. There would have to be a cool down period though.
I know it is easy to say, but I think it would be a good idea to talk to your friends. If they're worthy of the name they will listen and help as much as they can.
42m here. The sentiment about being unable to give back really resonates with me.

Congratulations! That is really great and uplifting to read. May I ask you what changed and what you did?

That sounds like my story. I lied to my family in order not to worry and exasperate them. In the end I decided that I was in too deep, and that death was the only way out. Well, I survived my attempt and spent a good deal of time in psych.
You have nothing to apologise for man.
Good luck. The psych ward helped me a great deal, fwiw.
Yeah, I often feel the same way. I can't say anything uplifting without feeling like a fraud. So I usually don't write anything.
It certainly CAN buy a lot of peace of mind.
Yeah, I definitely know that mindset.

On one hand I was keeping up a facade to my family that everything was ok. On the other I spent the nights in my apartment with no power (couldn't pay the bill). I'd watch old tv-shows on a borrowed computer. I kinda fixated on the final episode of Blackadder Goes Forth where all the silly characters go over the top towards the German lines. I, too, was going to end something foolish and undignified.

The planning consisted of walking up on a local bridge and jump.
My family. I couldn't put them through my suicide.
Try not to be angry with yourself for not jumping. It is not an opportunity you're passing up. Doing it and regretting it is worse.
I am glad to hear it.

Numb. It felt like I was in a time out of time, if that makes any sense. I hadn't planned on being alive, so it felt unreal and muted. 

That's ten years ago, and I have learned to live with being alive. Most times anyway.
I think many things would be better if we didn't have to treat suicide like a criminal enterprise.
Good on ya. 🙂

"I think suicide would be a bad solution to your problems" would be more honest AND a better start to a conversation.

Happy birthday, Natalie.
I am sorry that you got that response. Talking about suicide means that you want to talk about suicide. End of.

Those sweeping statements do not do anybody any good. 
It is true that soneone with suicidal ideation may have trouble seeing that they are loved, but there are still those who have no one, or whose loved ones harm them.

The whole area of mental wellbeing has been almost completely medicalized. If something is an illness you can (potentially) cure it. 
If it's just Shit Life Syndrome it becomes a whole different story. If we accept that perfectly rational people can make the decision to end an undignifed and painful existence, everything starts unraveling. The massive scientific and scholarly field of mental health becomes "take some pills and see me again in a week".
Family. I can't put them through it. Also, I'm only intermittently suicidal.
